_what: Every broad exception handler that returns nothing and says nothing, named site by site with how many instances each site is accepted to hold (DSR-659).
_why_a_ratchet: Containment, not remediation. Most of this is upstream code that re-syncs from mims-harvard:main, so rewriting it would conflict on every sync. The accepted total may fall, never rise.
_how_to_lower_it: Make the handler tell the caller what failed -- return or assign something naming the error, status or reason -- or re-raise. Adding a log does not count: server logs are not the agent's channel.
_how_to_waive_one: Put '# silent-swallow: <reason>' inside the handler. The reason is required. Optional-dependency probes need no pragma; a try block that only imports is exempt structurally.
_note: The invariant: the accepted counts sum to exactly every swallow the scan finds, so a new one cannot hide behind a site that already holds one.
